defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.issue: luma-utc-recovery-keeper.service failed with 226/NAMESPACE in every live boot
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.root_cause: The keeper lists /run/luma-governance in InaccessiblePaths= without a '-' prefix; that directory was luma-admin's RuntimeDirectory and luma-admin runs only in installed mode, so it never existed in live mode and systemd refused to start the keeper. luma-utc-recovery-producer.path is bound to the keeper and stayed inactive, so recovery-mode authenticated time did not start
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.closes: sequence-17 known issue 'luma-utc-recovery-keeper.service failed in the optical diagnostic boot' (cause now captured)
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.source_fix: native/image/overlay/etc/tmpfiles.d/luma-governance.conf creates /run/luma-governance 0711 root:root at every boot and luma-admin no longer owns it as a RuntimeDirectory (it already verifies mode 0711 and treats an old socket as stale only on ConnectionRefused); luma-runtime-masks.conf creates /run/luma-broker and /run/luma-content-custody, which luma-content-data-observer masks, with their owners' modes
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.regression_test: native/tests/test_runtime_namespace_paths.py requires a boot-time creator for every unprefixed /run namespace path in every unit
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.live_mode_non_run_paths_checked_statical: The live-only keeper and recovery producer mask /var/lib/luma-os, which tmpfiles creates as the parent of model-qa and utc-windows after which the keeper is ordered; luma-resource-live's /var/lib/luma-broker comes from its own StateDirectory=

defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.issue: luma-platform verify /media/luma cannot stage the desktop payload in a 6 GiB live guest
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.root_cause: Live /var is a tmpfs without a size option, so it holds at most half of RAM; staging admission needs the payload plus a 64 MiB reserve, so the 3,462,000,640-byte sequence-18 payload needs more than 6732 MiB of RAM
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.source_fix: The refusal now states the RAM the payload needs instead of a stale fixed size; desktop installation evaluation uses a closed 8192 MiB VM fixture (desktop_vm_test.py, vm_memory.py) and the README states the requirement
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.operator_consequence: A physical machine booting the optical ISO needs more than about 6.6 GiB of RAM for live verify/install of the desktop payload; 8 GiB is the documented minimum
defects_found_and_fixed_in_source.booted_fix_evidence: pending sequence 19 optical smoke at 8192 MiB

next_source_cut.launch_step_note: The candidate19 freeze, source-test and Rust-test scripts were launched from PowerShell with a preceding wsl.exe sed carriage-return strip. wsl.exe consumed its backslash, so sed removed one trailing 'r' from each line ending in 'r'. In the freeze script this cut the final letter from one comment line ('...and their' became '...and thei') before execution; no command line changed. The source-test and Rust-test scripts had no such line and are byte-identical to what was written. The recorded hashes are of the content as executed. Later launches omit the sed step
